title: Passé composé with être
summary: Some verbs (DR MRS VANDERTRAMP and reflexives) use être + past participle. The participle agrees with the subject in gender and number.
full_explanation: Some verbs (DR MRS VANDERTRAMP and reflexives) use être + past participle. The participle agrees with the subject in gender and number. Learn meanings before drilling forms. Say each example aloud. Contrast English word order with French when helpful. Reuse the same lemmas in reading, dialogue, and exercises. Avoid story-memory quizzes — test forms and meanings only. When unsure, reopen the Words to learn first list in the lesson brief. Register matters: vous with strangers, tu with friends who offered it.
